capabilities.justification: Uses DateTime.now() to stamp time-based UUID v1 (microsecond clock) and v7 (millisecond clock) values.
Uses Random.secure() to draw OS entropy for v1 clock sequence and node ID, v4 bodies, and v7 random suffixes.

justification: UUID generator. Reads the system clock for time-based variants (v1, v7) and OS randomness for random components (v1, v4, v7). Name-based variants (v3, v5) are pure computation over the in-lane MD5 and SHA-1 packages.
